rows.text:
A new season of Elation begins, featuring the limited-time return of the invincible player "Silver Wolf LV.999"!
She's conquered the universe, unlocked every cosmic achievement... What's left to play?
"Reach the peak of 'Elation'? Boring... Since I've got the cartridge now, I make the rules~"

>>>"I'll join."
>>>And just like that, the game called "Punklorde" ended that day.
>>>Admin "ID: Elio" granted access.
>>>"ID: Silver Wolf" has joined the "Stellaron Hunters" faction, logging into the game "Cosmos."

"Companion System"
The girl used to be a lone wolf, but now she's got a few co-op allies: a lady with a 10.899 billion bounty on her head, and a guy and mech whose bounties are valued at 8.13 and 9.723 billion respectively.
"You all look pretty solid. Just don't drag me down."
She huffs and tosses a console each to all three.
"Wanna play a round?"

"Faction Buff"
Mastermind? Laughter's mischief?
"Come on. I don't mind being painted as the mastermind. Makes the game experience way more fun."
With enemy fire raining down from behind, she snapped her fingers, and Silver Wolf's graffiti plastered itself all over the latest wanted posters.
"Now try forgetting that. From now on, anytime someone mentions the Stellaron Hunters, they're immediately gonna think of Silver Wolf."

"Main Missions"
Administrator "ID: Elio" sets goals for the Hunters but doesn't restrict how they achieve them.
In those worlds ravaged by Stellarons, she witnessed her allies' special abilities.
"Toying with prey? Too elegant. I'm not that classy."
"Can't die? No catch?"
"Armor's here...I need a better-looking new set to play with too."
She calls out to Elio, frustration in her voice: 
"Hey, everyone else gets all these perks, so why do I have to start the mission from scratch?"

"WARNING"
Warning! Stellaron Hunters collection storage has been breached!
Warning! Top secret classified item, "Silver Wolf LV.999" Aether Cartridge has been stolen!
"How can I steal something that was mine in the first place? Leaving!"
The girl makes a face at the camera.
Warning! Unauthorized use of the "Silver Wolf LV.999" Cartridge will result in unpredictable consequences!
"As if... Just see how many ways of gameplay I can unlock with this!"

>>>"ID: Silver Wolf" has logged out of "Cosmos"
>>>"ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" has logged in to "Cosmos"
>>>Warning! Warning! Warning!
>>>"Script" detected █████

"Backstage Paintball" was the first thing that came to her mind. You toss a ball into the screen here, and it flies out from another screen halfway across the cosmos.
If a bunch of Masked Fools dared to feed her false intel and run their mouths...
"Come at me through the internet if you've got the guts."
...she'd be more than happy to oblige their wish. That bomb could blow their local tavern sky-high.

The "Formatting Gun" breaks down everything it touches into pixels, triggering a "shot" that formats all data.
"If I want to uncover the true face of the Pure Child of Anāsrava, I'll need to be able to get out of the Garden of Recollection in one piece..."
The girl imagined herself sneaking into the Garden, searching for clues...
"I might as well format the Memokeepers' memories too! They'll definitely be standing there stunned, watching me slip away like I'm a total stranger!"

"Greedy Snake," a curio modeled after the leviathan "Voracity." Originally shaped like a snake, but the more it eats, the more it transforms into a donut.
She forgot it on top of a volcano, but two system hours later, she spotted it immediately...
Because the volcano was gone.

The detention room door swung open, revealing a woman leaning against the door frame, gazing helplessly at the graffiti covering every inch of the walls.
"Playtime's over, Silver Wolf."
The girl tossed aside her marker with boredom.
"I've already figured out what I'm doing next time. You can't keep me locked up."
"Do you have any idea how much chaos you caused messing around with that cartridge?"
"Oh, I remember."
A sly grin spread across the girl's face.
"You mean how the Cosmic Big Lotto spit out a million jackpots and Oswaldo himself had to shut the whole thing down?"
"Or wait, are you talking about when the Harmonic Strings hit three wrong notes in a row? Totally unprecedented."
"You're not still on about Screwllum, are you? That was all fake. I didn't actually disassemble him into spare parts, okay? And even if I did, it's not like I'm scared of him getting payback."
The woman shook her head.
"I'm talking about you. You nearly didn't make it. That cartridge was controlling you."
The girl turned her head away.
"Don't need you worrying about me... Next time, I'll just come up with some new tricks."

>>> "ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" has logged out of "Cosmos"
>>> "ID: Silver Wolf" has logged in to "Cosmos"

The girl has an "achievement wall," on which she awards herself a digital badge every time she hits a goal.
By now, her achievements are too numerous to count...

Achievement: "Solo Maxxing"
Description: Become a living LEGEND in Punklorde
Status: Completed
Player Review: "For me, the hardest part wasn't surviving. It was staying in Punklorde and getting stuck in place."

Achievement: "Friend of the IPC"
Description: Evenly distribute the IPC's virtual currency among all "Star Cheetah" players
Status: Completed
Player Review: "They're pinning their year-end accounting discrepancies on us again. 'All for the Amber Lord' they say. More like 'Blame it all on the Stellaron Hunters.' Fine, have it your way. While I'm at it, might as well leak all their dirty laundry too... Hope they raise my bounty even higher."

Achievement: "Even Bladie Would Disapprove This"
Description: Tank all the attacks from the cyberdemons in Jepella, the city of sins
Status: Completed
Player Review: "That time in Jepella, I left behind a super cool line in the sky: 'City of sins, I absolve you from being guilty.'"

Achievement: "What a Genius"
Description: Engage in an information battle against a Genius and obtain an ASSS rating.
Status: Completed
Player Review: "Is Screwllum a sore loser or what? Using admin privileges to force-disconnect me? Talk about playing dirty!"
...

The girl kept smashing her own records, yet at the end of that achievement wall, one badge remained unlit.
Engraved on it was a figure similar to her own, but far more flamboyant. It was the vision of some possible future, standing at the peak of Elation, having reached the absolute limit: "Silver Wolf LV.999..."

Achievement: "GAME NOT OVER"
Status: Incomplete
Description: Break through the LV.999 limit and keep this game going forever.

"First off, as a diehard veteran player of 'αWolf,' let me roast the previous game's producer
...Aha's just an Aeon of Elation who doesn't know jack about making games.

Forcing me to start with a brutal opening like "Wandering Orphan," grinding experience with that starter cartridge? Talk about a slog! Would it kill you to let me have some fun?
Once I survived the opening, things got way better. Becoming the overlord of the Dark Zone Empire, recruiting the Rangers and taverns, and becoming the new master of Device IX, pretty cool stuff. But then the game just... ends? Seriously? What a cop-out!
Good thing I knew about your level cap setting, LV.999. Otherwise, making me fight someone who looks exactly like me, and every attack she makes is like saying "Tired. I am so done..." Do you have ANY idea how terrifying that is!?

Anyway, back to business! "αWolf Online," which I've been working on for ages, is finally ready to meet you all.
To address the pain points mentioned above, I've made the following improvements:

1. Massive Time-Saver! No Grind Required, Level up with One Click
Just complete the Stellaron Hunter bootcamp, and you'll unlock the latest form with a single click, gaining brand-new powerful items. Trust me, it'll carry you to victory!
2. New Feature! Experience the Story Your Way
When Elation arrives, even the script has to step aside. Play however you want, whenever you want.
3. New Mode! Face a challenge without limit in the Infinite DLC
Say goodbye to boring grinding. The best part of the game is always ahead. Hit LV.999? So what? Beyond the peak of Elation, there's an even higher summit waiting.

Aha, see that? Now THIS is what a next-gen game looks like.
But by choosing αWolf Online, you've chosen "Nightmare Mode." A one-life clear is just the baseline. And every boss is different from the last.
So, you're probably wondering: What happens when you fail?

Of course, the odds of that happening are basically zero. But if it does, I hope everyone playing this game remembers:
This cartridge chronicles an unprecedented hacker's journey. Reaching the end is important, but having more fun along the way is even more important!

Next up, get ready for the grand opening of αWolf Online!
To all you folks watching, I wish you joy, and I wish myself a blast!"

— Message from developer Silver Wolf
